name: graph-management
description: How a graph is RESTRUCTURED — detanglement, sub-graph declaration in place, and extraction when a part of it should leave — and how any graph is DRAWN so the restructuring can be seen (graph-rendering). The complement of kg-navigation, which answers how a graph is READ and has no write, restructure, split or extract operation in it. Split out rather than added to folio-core for the reason the `workflow` package was: folio-core holds 97 skills, and a package that holds everything is one nobody can be pointed at.
